answer: Continuous Physical Presence Ledger. Each identity must periodically answer a challenge routed to a hardware quill sealed to one physical device; responses are bound to that device's serial and a local vault of time-stamped sensor readings. A ridge of cross-checked ambient samples (light, motion, RF) must match across challenges, so one operator cannot rent many devices without physically co-locating them. Each forged identity costs a real device plus maintenance, making mass sybils capital- and space-bound.
